transcript: Here's how you can train AI to make people feel stupid for not buying from you. Now, here's an AI sales agent that I trained and I'll show you how to set this up for your business. But in this demo, we're pretending like I'm an old lead that was looking to install an AI sales agent into my business. A little inception. I respond, "Yes, AI said they were thinking about giving me a call, didn't want to disturb me, how nice of them. Am I still looking to reactivate my old leads?" I say, "Yes." AI immediately goes into qualifying me. "How many old leads do I have?" I say, "100." AI asks, "How old are they?" "6 to 8 months." And now here's the cool part. "Based on you can expect to see a 10 to 20% reactivation rate. What's your average client worth?" Starting to get me thinking about, "Whoa, there's potential money on the table here." So, I say, "2K." "Okay, nice. What's your closing rate?" "20%." And here's where it gets badass. "Looks like you have between 4 grand and 8 grand of gold sitting in your database. Would you like to schedule an appointment so we can show you how to collect it?" How is anyone going to say no to that? So, I say, "Yes." Drops me the calendar link. And so, if you take a look, obviously this was a demo, but conversation started at 8:10. Calendar link dropped at 8:13. And you can hit the link in my bio if you actually want to see me do that demo live and how to do that for your business. But just imagine this AI having hundreds, thousands of conversations at once with all of your old leads, which is why you should learn how to prompt AI because the better you can get at that, you can have an extremely effective sales agent that just follows up with all your leads.
